---
name: verify-quality
description: Design and review meaningful tests, assess behavioral coverage, and verify e-store test suites and build artifacts during implementation and refactoring.
---

Follow [the shared quality verification skill](../../../agents/skills/verify-quality/SKILL.md) and `agents/test-build-reviewer.md`. Resolve commands from the repository root. Reject shallow tests, distinguish unit/integration/E2E evidence, run required checks and packaging, and report failures, missing coverage, skipped suites, and unavailable tools accurately.
